messages:
lina_pm: Quick sync: FoldGate reached out about an orchestration adapter for their gateway + LangChain flows. They want a preflight checklist before we open a marketplace listing. Can we draft one here?

oz_devrel: Yes. Main items: adapter auth modes, retriever interface, tool-calling pass-through, and backpressure handling for continuous batching.

theo_infra: Also add deployment matrix: supported Redwood runtime versions, quantization compatibility, and GPU vs CPU latency expectations.

rachel_marketing: We'll need partner logo assets, short description (<= 160 chars), and 1-2 screenshots. Also confirm co-marketing windows.

foldgate-bot: FoldGate: Thanks! We can provide logos + test endpoints. Security point: we only support mTLS + token combos.

lina_pm: Good. Draft checklist idea: dev validation, perf sweep, retriever smoke, SI integration runbook, security signoff, billing integration test, marketplace copy.

oz_devrel: I'll own the dev validation and sample notebook. Target: end-to-end LangChain notebook showing a retriever -> gateway -> model flow, with function calls.

theo_infra: I'll run perf sweep. Want to run against three shapes: short chat (64 tokens), long generation (1024 tokens), and streaming retriever loop. Will report p50/p95 and GPU memory.

oz_devrel: Notebook snippet for retriever wiring:

```python
from langchain import RetrievalQA
qa = RetrievalQA.from_chain_type(
  llm=FoldGateAdapter(api_key=ENV['FOLD_KEY']),
  retriever=my_vectorstore.as_retriever()
)
print(qa.run("How many shards in the index?"))
```

rachel_marketing: For marketplace bullets: 1) Plug-and-play gateway adapter for LangChain/LlamaIndex; 2) Low-latency streaming support; 3) Enterprise auth (mTLS). Keep it punchy.

ci-bot: CI: folded tests triggered for branch foldgate/adapter-preflight. 12 tests running.

lina_pm: Risks to call out: retriever API mismatch with some vector stores, streaming semantics (server push) differences, and billing rounding if we double-count gateway proxy tokens. Add these to the playbook.

oz_devrel: Noted. I'll create a small shim in the notebook to reconcile token accounting and include a test harness URL.

theo_infra: Proposed timeline: prototype in sandbox by Apr 12, perf and SI run Apr 14-18, legal/security signoff Apr 20, marketplace listing Apr 26. Is that aggressive?

lina_pm: Slightly aggressive but ok if we keep scope minimal for listing. Marketing needs 5 business days for assets, legal 3 business days. I'll coordinate.

rachel_marketing: I'll block May 1-5 for a joint webinar slot if the pilot goes well.

oz_devrel: Action items: oz -> notebook + shim by Apr 10; theo -> perf harness + initial numbers Apr 14; rachel -> marketplace copy draft Apr 12; lina -> coordinate legal and schedule.

foldgate-bot: FoldGate: We'll provide test endpoints and logos by Apr 6. Open to a joint webinar.

lina_pm: Thanks everyone. I'll create the partner channel #partner-foldgate-orch and invite all on this thread. Quick pulse check: any blockers we missed?

theo_infra: None from infra but will need temporary quota bump for perf runs.

oz_devrel: No blockers.

rachel_marketing: No blockers.

lina_pm: Great 0I'll post meeting invite and close the loop.
